05-31-1508 is May 31, 1508.  
18 weeks + 7 days = 19 weeks = 133 days.  
Subtract 133 days from May 31, 1508.  
April has 30 days, so May 31 minus 31 days = May 0 → April 30.  
133 - 31 = 102 days left to subtract from April 30.  
March has 31 days: April 30 minus 31 days = March 30.  
102 - 31 = 71 days left.  
February 1508 is a leap year (divisible by 4, Gregorian calendar not adopted yet but still leap by Julian rule): 29 days.  
March 30 minus 29 days = March 1.  
71 - 29 = 42 days left.  
January has 31 days: March 1 minus 31 days = January 30 (of same year 1508).  
42 - 31 = 11 days left.  
Subtract 11 days from January 30 → January 19, 1508.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1508-01-19
